subject.title: fix(qa): simplify smoke lanes and isolate fanout

question: Should automatic QA Smoke prioritize a bounded 12-scenario taxonomy-representative set instead of executing every eligible smoke scenario?
rationale: The final implementation is correct and substantially faster, but regression-detection breadth versus runner/runtime cost is an intentional CI policy choice that cannot be resolved from tests alone.

options.title: Adopt representative smoke
options.body: Merge the proven two-profile design, retain broad execution in explicit QA profiles, and align the PR description before landing.

options.title: Retain broad automatic smoke
options.body: Keep every eligible scenario in automatic CI and apply only the package-reuse, Playwright-focus, and worker-isolation improvements.

recommendation.title: Adopt representative smoke
recommendation.body: Merge the proven two-profile design, retain broad execution in explicit QA profiles, and align the PR description before landing.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent implementation and exact-run context for the coverage and fanout tradeoff.
